gloss: fraction of a second; very short time period
definitions: A stopwatch with two second hands, each of which may be stopped separately to time the intervals of a race by a sportsperson, or to time more than one sportsperson.
A fraction of a second; hence (figurative, also attributive) a very short time period; an instant, a moment.

ja.k: せちな, sechina (archaic); せつな, setsuna
